thread:
Maria (partnerships): kicking off CarbonBridge EAP — focus: thermal profile + perf stability under our quantized stacks. NDA in place but legal wants an addendum. We need a short bench plan and telemetry contract by Friday.
Kevin (eng-ml): noted. main risk: KV-cache churn + fused-kernel hot paths cause power spikes on their boards. we should capture per-GPU power + Tdie every 1s.
Ryan (bench): can do. requesting lab creds for their board image and a serial console. I'll also run a 2-hour burn-in overnight.
Olivia (product): timeline question — do partners expect a joint announcement after EAP? or just a tech preview? want to align comms.
Sia (legal): we need an NDA addendum that covers telemetry sharing and non-disclosure of thermals as marketing claims. I'll draft and share by EOD.
Kevin (eng-ml): propose bench checklist snippet for consistency:
```
MODEL=redwood-v1
BATCHES=200
SEQ=2048
COLLECT_POWER=1s
LOG_DEST=s3://rb-internal/carbonbridge/eap
```
Ryan (bench): perfect. i'll wrap that into a runbook and include df + nvml logs. also will export raw traces for perf regression checks.
AetherBot: New EAP workspace created: carbonbridge-eap. Access requests: runbook-owner=Ryan, analytics-read=Olivia, legal-view=Sia.
Maria (partnerships): Ryan pls add expected test matrix (models, quant levels, batch sizes) in the runbook. Kevin — can you add the kernel build variant we want tested?
Kevin (eng-ml): adding q4_8 + q5_4 quant builds. also will include a CPU baseline for thermal delta.
Olivia (product): comms plan: hold announcement until we validate perf/cost delta and sign-off from legal + partner. target internal review next Thu.
Sia (legal): NDA addendum sent to partner legal (no redlines expected). please don't share raw board serials outside bench team.
Ryan (bench): lab access requested: carbon-bridge-01. pinging infra for network/firewall exceptions.
Maria (partnerships): thanks everyone — short action items: Sia send addendum, Ryan post runbook + matrix, Kevin push kernel tags, Olivia draft comms outline. check-in Friday 2pm PT. :thumbsup:
Kevin (eng-ml): :thumbsup: will push tags by tomorrow.
Ryan (bench): on it, will post runbook link here when ready.
Olivia (product): adding calendar invite for Fri 2pm PT.
Maria (partnerships): closing thread for now — drop any blockers here.
